title: Black sites staffed by refugees who didn't make the P3 cut

tellings.quote: They got their own people to manage these things like these refugees they get from these other countries that they scream for P3 that don't cut make the cut. Well, they have them as janitors, cooks, you know, people to maintain these facilities.

plain: Secret government facilities, often called black sites, are said to be run day to day by refugees from other countries who applied for resettlement under what he calls P3, a refugee category, and were turned down. They are kept on instead as janitors, cooks and maintenance staff. This comes from Michael Herrera, a former Marine who says he saw a huge craft in the Indonesian jungle, repeating what someone told him, and it would mean these hidden places keep their secrets by using workers with nowhere else to go.
